architecture_recommendation.3d: Three.js through React Three Fiber + drei; geometry logic isolated from rendering
architecture_recommendation.maps: provider abstraction: Google Maps/Places for live commercial place data where licensed; OSM-derived canonical geospatial base where appropriate
architecture_recommendation.search: Postgres FTS initially; OpenSearch/Typesense adapter if scale requires
architecture_recommendation.storage: object storage with rights metadata on every asset
architecture_recommendation.jobs: queue for ingestion, refresh, image processing, geocoding, dedupe, structured-data generation
architecture_recommendation.auth: role-based mosque admin / contributor / reviewer / supplier / architect / public user
architecture_recommendation.payments: provider abstraction; Stripe-first plus region-specific adapters such as mobile money
architecture_recommendation.analytics: privacy-minimized product analytics + server-side conversion events
architecture_recommendation.cms: structured content tables + review workflows rather than freeform-only CMS

code_harness_context: Treat all *queue* files as research targets, not factual entities
Never generate or infer permit approval
Never persist Google content beyond allowed terms; store canonical internal record + provider reference/provenance
Keep source_id/rights_status/verified_at in every imported entity
Every new feature must add route/state/analytics/test entries
Three.js geometry rules live in pure deterministic modules testable without WebGL
Cost engine stores assumption source, geography, currency, date and confidence range
Religious-content claims need review status separate from general editorial review
